name: Yumi Mutchiri
source:
Yumi is the math teacher at Vesper University, where she also manages a small math league that works on unsolvable equations. Although she has a tendency to use her assets to her advantage, she seems to be much more bark than bite.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
